newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica JSE sets further market cap all time high. [CORRECTED 10:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: SAfrica JSE sets further market cap all time high. [CORRECTED 10:35 GMT]

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) announced on Monday it had recorded an all-time high of 1,212 billion (corrects from 1.212 billion) rand for its market capitalisation on February 21.
The exchange said in a statement it recorded a previous high of 1,210 billion (corrects from 1.210 billion) rand on February 19.
